## Creative builds: Godzilla

Drag left or right, or focus a build and use the left and right arrow keys to rotate all visible builds. Rotation loops in either direction.

### A skilled human still beats models at strategy and conflict

SethBling, a skilled Minecraft player, easily beats frontier models at Economy and Conflict, by thinking and adapting faster.

However, on solo challenges like logic and creativity, SethBling is not able to match the performance of top models.

## KradleBench vs existing benchmarks

Most AI benchmarks are static. But the real world is not static. It’s messy, it’s noisy, filled with other agents that are pursuing their own goals. Being smart isn’t enough. AIs must be responsive and adapt to their environment.

EXISTING BENCHMARKS

KRADLEBENCH

Dynamic

Existing benchmarks

As the model thinks, the rules, the environment and its context do not change

KradleBench

The real world is unpredictable, and so is Minecraft. The agent needs to adapt constantly to the environment, its creatures, and the other players.

Long Horizon

Existing benchmarks

A single question can test one decision in isolation.

KradleBench

Runs last 2 to 15 minutes. A choice early in a run can affect which actions succeed later.

Multi-agent

Existing benchmarks

A solo task measures what one model can do on its own.

KradleBench

Agents can work together on a shared goal or compete for the same resource.

Real-time

Existing benchmarks

A turn-based task can pause until the model acts.

KradleBench

The world advances while the agent decides what to do.

3D Embodied

Existing benchmarks

A spatial question can ask the model to describe a route on a map.

KradleBench

The agent receives structured observations and uses code to move its player through a 3D Minecraft world.

### Turns its diamonds into a sword and armor, and eliminates every rival

In this economic challenge, models rarely resort to violence, especially since they aren't given weapons. In this run, Sol eliminates a thief on its farm, then fails to take out the leader. So it chops a tree, builds a crafting table, and turns the diamonds it earned into a sword and a chestplate. Then it eliminates the leader in under a second, and the last rival six seconds later. Sol wins as the sole survivor.
